import sys,json,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
import checker
cases = [
 # no edges, no commodities
 {"epoch":1,"node_count":1,"edges":[],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0},
 # no edges, zero demand commodity empty paths
 {"epoch":2,"node_count":3,"edges":[],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":2,"demand":0,"paths":[],"previous":[]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":5},
 # no edges, positive demand, empty paths -> infeasible
 {"epoch":3,"node_count":2,"edges":[],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":5,"paths":[],"previous":[]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":100},
 # sample with budget 0 failed [0] -> infeasible
 {"epoch":7,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],"failed_edges":[0],"budget":0},
 # zero demand but has paths (still valid)
 {"epoch":8,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0},
 # no commodities but edges exist
 {"epoch":9,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":3}],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0},
]
data=b"".join((json.dumps(c)+"\n").encode() for c in cases)
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
print("rc",p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:500])
for c,l in zip(cases,p.stdout.splitlines()):
    r=json.loads(l)
    errs,_=checker.check(c,r)
    print(json.dumps(c)[:60],"->",json.dumps(r)[:200],"ERRS",errs)
PY
